source.label: Prysai logo / supplied raster source
source.identity_rule: Use the same source mark in every theme. Change motion language, stage treatment, and sequencing only.

request_example.user_says: I want to make a logo animation for my artificial-intelligence company.
request_example.routing_explanation: The phrase artificial intelligence selects AI-field; the result uses organized signal convergence and a quiet canonical landing.

themes.name: System-spatial
themes.intent: Make the mark feel native to a coherent product system: parts travel from semantic positions into one stable lockup.
themes.result: Panels align, then the mark resolves with no decorative noise.
themes.qa: spatial continuity; no layout shift; focus order

themes.name: Premium-quiet
themes.public_analogue: Editorial motion and Apple-style purpose / hierarchy principles
themes.intent: Create perceived value through stillness, optical alignment, and a late, controlled reveal of the highest-value contour.
themes.result: The logo emerges from near-black with one calm highlight pass.
themes.qa: contour integrity; optical centering; calm frame pacing

themes.name: Developer-open
themes.trigger: developer, open source, API, CLI, tooling
themes.intent: Expose a causal chain that a technical audience can inspect: named phases, stable actors, and reproducible replay.
themes.result: A terminal-like assembly trace resolves into the unchanged source mark.

themes.name: AI-field
themes.trigger: AI, artificial intelligence, neural, generative, data
themes.public_analogue: Public AI-product motion patterns; no private vendor recipe is claimed
themes.intent: Suggest intelligence through organized transformation: signals are guided into the mark's actual geometry, not random sci-fi decoration.
themes.result: A field of restrained points converges into the supplied Prysai identity and then goes quiet.
themes.qa: determinism; semantic landing; reduced motion; performance

themes.name: Fintech-trust
themes.public_analogue: Predictable system feedback and calm state-transition principles
themes.intent: Make motion feel dependable: a guarded sequence moves from processing to a clear, reversible resolution.
themes.result: A measured progress ring completes before the mark enters its stable state.
themes.qa: state correctness; cancellation; contrast; no false success

themes.name: Security-shield
themes.public_analogue: Accessible system motion with clear focus and user control
themes.intent: Reveal the boundary first, verify the interior second, and make the final state unambiguous.
themes.result: A perimeter closes around the source mark before the identity is unlocked.

themes.name: Commerce-energy
themes.intent: Give the mark a quick, friendly response to an action while returning rapidly to a stable idle state.
themes.result: A compact burst surrounds the mark, then settles before the next action.
themes.qa: input latency; repeat action; touch-safe range

themes.name: Automotive-precision
themes.intent: Express mass and direction with controlled acceleration, stable anchors, and no weightless teleportation.
themes.result: A directional light sweep passes across a mark that settles like a precision component.

themes.name: Sports-impact
themes.intent: Build tension, release along a dominant axis, and preserve silhouette recognition at peak speed.
themes.result: The source mark compresses, cuts forward, and snaps back into a readable lockup.
themes.qa: peak silhouette; deformation limit; flashing risk

themes.name: Cinematic-title
themes.trigger: film, title, trailer, story, dramatic, suspense
themes.public_analogue: Title-sequence staging grammar, not a studio pipeline claim
themes.intent: Use silence, scale, and compositional focus to stage one identity moment without obscuring the final silhouette.
themes.result: The logo moves through a dark title frame and pauses long enough to be read.
themes.qa: final readability; crop safety; contrast; static fallback

themes.name: Nature-flow
themes.public_analogue: Continuous curves and variable-velocity organic motion
themes.intent: Follow the mark's curves with low-frequency motion that implies growth without erasing topology.
themes.result: Soft contour-following arcs carry the mark into a calm canonical endpoint.
themes.qa: smoothness; amplitude bounds; topology; loop seam

themes.name: Gaming-world
themes.trigger: gaming, esports, fantasy, sci-fi, arcade, playful
themes.public_analogue: Interactive-entertainment motion grammar; no game asset is copied
themes.intent: Treat the logo as the hero object and use deterministic secondary effects to signal reward and replay.
themes.result: A controlled ring of reward particles frames the unchanged mark, then clears for readability.
themes.qa: readability; deterministic replay; flashing limits; performance

themes.name: Accessibility-first
themes.trigger: accessible, reduced motion, calm, inclusive, keyboard
themes.intent: Design the static state first, then use opacity and small translation only when motion adds orientation or feedback.
themes.result: The canonical mark is immediately legible; movement becomes optional context, not the meaning.
themes.qa: reduced motion; focus; contrast; static equivalence
